name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For safety, the caller must ensure that a specific value of T is dropped at most once, even if the returned Arc<T> is never accessed.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::sync::Arc < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: “dropped at most once” requires drop-event history and future behavior, neither of which is modeled.
